# S02 · Storefront

[All stages](README.md) · [Wave 2](README.md#wave-2) · [README dashboard](../../README.md#all-28-stages) · [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02--storefront--pr-4088)

> **বাংলায় — দোকানের সামনের অংশ:**
> - কাস্টমার যে পাতাগুলো দেখে — হোম, ক্যাটাগরি, পণ্যের পাতা, সার্চ — সব এই ধাপে।
> - ডিজাইন হুবহু অনুমোদিত ডেমো V12.1-এর মতো, ফোনের দিকে আগে নজর।
> - পেজ সাজানো, লেখা বদলানো আর থিম — সব অ্যাডমিন থেকে করা যাবে।

**Done:** 33 / 58 PRs (In progress) · **Wave:** 2 · **PR numbers:** 40–88, 501, 503, 595–600, 602 · **Register status:** locked; UI in review

*The largest stage. It carries the page builder, the three product-page templates, the themes, and everything the twelve UI/UX review rounds settled.*

**Blueprint:** [D10. Page and site building tools (V2 · S02 · PR 595–600)](../BLUEPRINT.md#d10-page-and-site-building-tools-v2--s02--pr-595600)

  - **19 Oct 19:53** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02-additions--owners-desktop-review-19-oct-1838): **Owner, 19 Oct 19:53:** will turn it on; master on/off stays in the backend (off = today's look). ## PR 598

**Site builder — the whole site dynamic (owner, 19 Oct 21:23: "like WordPress + Elementor, nothing fixed")**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “দোকানের সামনের অংশ” ধাপের অংশ: কাস্টমার যা দেখে: হোম, ক্যাটাগরি, পণ্যের পাতা, সার্চ, মেনু আর পেজ সাজানোর টুল।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (partial) · paused (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Site builder — the whole site dynamic (owner, 19 Oct 21:23: "like WordPress + Elementor, nothing fixed").** From the backend, with preview before publish: **menus** (header nav / mega menu / phone menu / bottom bar — add, rename, reorder, hide, custom links, featured tile), **header** (announcement bar, icons on/off and order, logo), **footer** (columns, links, texts, contact block, social and payment marks), **categories and sub-categories** (create, rename, reorder, hide, image, intro, SEO), **product page blocks** (order and visibility of gallery, price row, colours, sizes, offers, buy-together, reviews, FAQ, care link), **content pages** (help, policies, about, careers, payment — rich text editor), **theme** (colours, fonts, spacing tokens with contrast check). Builds on PR 595 (home/category sections), 596 (side canvas) and 597 (launch default / snapshots / undo). Every change: draft → preview on phone/tablet/desktop → publish; per-device visibility; version history and undo. **Guardrails, not a blank canvas:** blocks snap to the responsive grid (no free pixel dragging that breaks phones), contrast and tap-size checks block bad publishes, checkout keeps its tested structure (texts, fields on/off and order editable; payment steps locked). Handover-ready: every default is data, a new owner configures everything here, the owner's own data never ships (PR 509).
- **Filed under:** [S02 additions — owner's desktop review (19 Oct 18:38)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02-additions--owners-desktop-review-19-oct-1838)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**

Clicking any link to the page you are on (e.g. the logo on home) scrolls to the top.
  - **19 Oct 22:27** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02-additions--owners-desktop-review-19-oct-1838): **Owner 22:27:** a Shimmer control (every shimmer on the site: on/off, speed, intensity, master switch, reduced motion); tiered bag offers (Take 2 / 3 / 4 with prices and savings, fully customisable); side-canvas zones on every page with gutters (home, category, login, bag; never checkout).
  - **20 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02-additions--owners-desktop-review-19-oct-1838): **V2.1 final · 20 Oct:** both owner 22:27 items are built in the demo (Batch B): **Shimmer control** — Admin › Settings › Shimmer, 14 shimmers each with on/off, speed and strength, plus a master switch; reduce-motion gets no shimmer; the Add to Bag shimmer exists but is off by default (89t-shimmer.js); **tiered bag offers** — the "Take 2 │ Take 3 │ Take 4" box with gold bars from the Build your own set price rules, up to 4 tiers per rule, dates and targeting, desktop only with a phone preview (89u-bag-offers.js). The rest of PR 598 stays paused.
  - **20 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (V2.1 final · 20 Oct — pre-code demo work finished; blueprint V2.1 final; no new PR numbers)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-606): **PR 98 / 107 / 109 / 598 (bag, owner review 43.3–43.10, Batch B)** — bag title, Continue shopping, shimmer on FREE, "You save" in sale red, duplicate-size box, line titles, plain bag words (15 labels with Bengali), Shimmer control (14 + master; none under reduce-motion; Add to Bag shimmer off by default), tier box "Take 2 │ Take 3 │ Take 4" (desktop only; phone preview only). Owner decision pending: the suggested 4-piece prices (BAG_TIER_SEED) — blueprint Appendix B.4 #13.

## PR 600

**On-page edit mode (owner, 19 Oct 22:27–22:33, plan approved 100%)**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “দোকানের সামনের অংশ” ধাপের অংশ: কাস্টমার যা দেখে: হোম, ক্যাটাগরি, পণ্যের পাতা, সার্চ, মেনু আর পেজ সাজানোর টুল।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed · paused (not in demo) (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **On-page edit mode (owner, 19 Oct 22:27–22:33, plan approved 100%).** Logged in as super admin, a thin bar on every storefront page turns on Edit mode (customers never see it): hover a section → outline + Edit; click → side panel with that section's settings (texts, prices, products, offer tiers, shimmer, hide); "+" between sections adds one; draft shown in place → Publish → undo. Same engine as the site builder (PR 598), two doors. On phone: a light version (texts and offers only, no drag). **Desktop change → "Apply to phone too?"** If yes: previews on the **10 phone screen sizes most used in Bangladesh** (the owner can pick any to check by hand) plus automatic checks (nothing cut, no sideways scroll, tap size, buy button above the fold); it goes to phone only after the checks pass and the owner approves. **AI mode:** when on, an AI reviewer agent tests the change across phones, tablets and desktops (layout, speed, conversion rules, customer impact) and returns a short report — "safe to publish" or "Boss, don't publish: …" with reasons and screenshots; when AI mode is off it says so and the owner's own check stands. Guardrails as PR 598; checkout payment steps locked.

## PR 602

**Four-layer cache plus invalidation — browser, Cloudflare, server page cache, Redis; purge rules; 15 s stock display with live checks at …**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “দোকানের সামনের অংশ” ধাপের অংশ: কাস্টমার যা দেখে: হোম, ক্যাটাগরি, পণ্যের পাতা, সার্চ, মেনু আর পেজ সাজানোর টুল।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Four-layer cache plus invalidation (owner server spec, 19 Oct 23:33).** **Browser** (images, CSS, JS, fonts for a long time, hashed file names) → **Cloudflare** (static files long; category and product pages for a few minutes, duration in settings; cart, checkout, account and admin never cached) → **server page cache** (built HTML for minutes, renewed the moment something changes) → **Redis** (settings, the Dhaka area list, products, categories, stock display). **Purge rules:** price change → that product, its category pages and the CDN; stock change → instantly; settings change → every place that setting is used; new product → category pages and the sitemap. **Stock:** the display cache lasts 15 s and every stock change event purges it at once; **add-to-bag and checkout always read live stock with a row lock (PR 198)** — nothing oversells. An admin **"Clear all cache"** button; cache hit %% on the Server page (PR 423). All durations are settings. Pre-launch required.
- **Filed under:** [S02 addition — four-layer cache (owner server spec, 19 Oct 23:33; CN-001)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02-addition--four-layer-cache-owner-server-spec-19-oct-2333-cn-001)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **19 Oct 23:33** · [Scope added to existing PRs (owner server spec, CN-001; review/SERVER-SETUP-SPEC-OWNER.md; new PR 601–604)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-606): **The filing** — the owner approved every point of the analysis at 23:33 and said: where two decisions conflict, take the best one. Four new PRs (601 NVMe boot unit and 604 hardware-aware profile in S0A, 603 database performance pack in S00, 602 four-layer cache in S02); the rest is dated scope on the PR lines below (PR 1, 3–10, 13, 18, 22, 24, 37, 72, 88, 234, 519). **Every server item is required before go-live** — the owner's "later" list (monitoring page, monthly speed measurement, report pre-computation) is not deferred; items that need the app schema are built with their stage and marked *pre-launch required*. **Build order inside S0A:** 1 record specs (PR 1) → 2 hardening and UFW (PR 3) → 3 NVMe boot unit (PR 601) → 4 data-disk LVM (PR 1/3) → 5 Docker (PR 4) → 6 hardware-aware profile (PR 604) → 7 Postgres, PgBouncer and Redis tuning (PR 5, 6) → 8 Caddy, Cloudflare and Origin …
  - **20 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (V2.1 final · 20 Oct — pre-code demo work finished; blueprint V2.1 final; no new PR numbers)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-606): **Server admin pages in the demo (CN-001; sample numbers, labelled)** — `#/admin/server` → PR 423 / 601 / 603 / 604; `#/admin/cache` → PR 602; `#/admin/images` → PR 22 / 24 / 88; `#/admin/speed` → PR 234; `#/admin/integrations` ("Keys & connections") → PR 493 / 500; `#/admin/backup` now shows Blob + Drive → PR 8 / 395 / 507. Checks: 120 route/modal checks 0 fails + 19 flows.
